review.note: Merge-integrity review of the 3 wave-1 no-ff merge commits (8a498553 SLICE-205, 0df469ff SLICE-206, 67017b5e SLICE-208) into runner-plugin main, per SLICE-01 AC-1/AC-2. All 5 checks pass. `git diff <merge>^2 main-SLICE-2xx` is empty for all three merges — merge trees are byte-identical to their branch tips, so no stray edits were smuggled in and no content was lost or half-merged. Reflog confirms all three were real `git merge` (ort strategy) two-parent commits at 16:12:45-52 on 2026-08-18, with the branches still pointing at their original build tips (unrewritten). AC-1's literal test passes: `git log main --grep=SLICE-205/206/208` each return commits and `git branch --merged main` lists all three branches. AC-2's narrative claim ("SLICE-207 never started") is true: no main-SLICE-207 branch exists (local or origin), and SLICE_207_....md is still under ai-loop/slices/pending/. Main is HEAD at 67017b5e, 14 commits ahead of origin/main (bcc769b8), confirmed not pushed. Working tree has only the two pre-existing/unrelated items the builder's handoff already disclosed (modified learnings.jsonl, 3 untracked devcrew-merge-plan review artifacts) — nothing from the merge leaked into the working tree.
